governance.reasoning: While promoter shares are entirely unpledged, the prospectus notes a SEBI disciplinary action/penalty history against promoters and a pending Income-tax Act Show Cause Notice [capital_structure, page 78; litigation, page 318].

key_risks.why_it_matters: A Show Cause Notice under Section 221(1) of the Income-tax Act and historical SEBI disciplinary actions/penalties against promoters create regulatory overhang [litigation, page 318].
Total debt of 9246.07 million heavily outweighs the latest net worth of 4107.67 million, increasing financial vulnerability [balance sheet].
Inability to continue using the domain name under the promoter's name (Abhishek Jindal) could adversely affect the company's business and brand [business, page 166].
